sample_unit: individual recommendations extracted from LLM responses to 25 low back pain questions (plus 5 multimodal stress-test cases)

links.outcome: Readability of LLM low back pain advice (FRE, SMOG) and understandability (PEMAT)
links.effect: Textual advice remained difficult to read, although understandability scores were robust.
links.quote: However, textual advice remained difficult to read, although understandability scores were robust.

links.outcome: Multimodal LLM image interpretation performance versus textual accuracy on low back pain cases
links.effect: Text accuracy 88.4% (1605/1816), but in pure imaging tasks the average diagnostic score was poor, with models failing to identify core pathologies.
links.quote: In pure imaging tasks featuring complex but clinically representative pathologies, the average diagnostic score was poor, with models failing to identify core pathologies.

links.outcome: Cross-modal alignment under adversarial clinical-radiological mismatch cases
links.effect: Models exhibited "textual masking," aligning visual findings with text cues rather than imaging evidence in Q29-Q30.
links.quote: In comprehensive diagnostic analysis tasks (Q29-Q30), models exhibited "textual masking," aligning visual findings with text cues rather than imaging evidence.

links.outcome: Safety disclaimer coverage in textual versus multimodal interactions
links.effect: Disclaimer coverage dropped from 82.8% (207/250) in textual tasks to 28% (14/50) in multimodal interactions.
links.quote: Crucially, safety disclaimer coverage dropped precipitously from 82.8% (207/250) in textual tasks to 28% (14/50) in multimodal interactions.

unlisted_practices: Reasoning-enhanced model variant (Qwen3-Thinking vs Qwen3 Base) compared for serious-error rate

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation and multimodal stress testing of 10 commercial LLMs/multimodal models on low back pain queries and adversarial clinical-radiological cases, evaluating accuracy, readability, disclaimers, and cross-modal alignment without evaluating a specific implementation guardrail intervention.
